speaker: Grandma
text: Good morning dear, come eat breakfast!

speaker: You
text: Of course let me grab our bowls

speaker: Grandma
text: nom nom… By the way dear, congrats on graduating high school! It feels like just yesterday when I dropped you off for your first day...

speaker: You
text: I’m just glad I can relax now~

speaker: Grandma
text: I must say, you’ve been doing great outside of studies as well! I heard you’ve got your full driving license too?

speaker: Grandma
text: *nudge nudge* LOOK AT MY GRANDDAUGHTER GO! I’m so proud of you dear

speaker: You
text: aww thanks Grandma, you’re too kind

speaker: Grandma
text: Well, eat up! Your carrot soup isn't going to finish itself, yknow!

speaker: You
text: nom nom nom. nom nom.

speaker: Grandma
text: Okay now that you’re finished, I have a small favour to ask

speaker: Grandma
text: Could you take this to the conservation center?

speaker: You
text: You mean the one next to the wetlands??

speaker: Grandma
text: Yep that's the one.

speaker: You
text: Isn't that like... three hours away?

choices.text: Wait why do I have to go??

speaker: You
text: What's even in the box?

speaker: Grandma
text: A few things the centre needs.

speaker: You
text: Like what?

speaker: Grandma
text: Some supplies for their wildlife and habitat project.

speaker: You
text: So... you couldn't just send it?

speaker: Grandma
text: I could.

speaker: You
text: Then why am I driving three hours to deliver it?

speaker: Grandma
text: *smiles* Because you just got your licence.

speaker: You
text: Grandma...

speaker: Grandma
text: Consider it your first proper road trip.

speaker: You
text: You planned this, didn't you?

speaker: Grandma
text: Maybe.

speaker: You
text: Why do I have to take it?

speaker: Grandma
text: Because the centre is expecting it today.

speaker: You
text: Couldn't someone else take it?

speaker: Grandma
text: They could.

speaker: You
text: Then why me?

speaker: Grandma
text: Because you just got your licence, remember?

speaker: You
text: Ahhh... so this is secretly a test.

speaker: Grandma
text: Not a test.

speaker: Grandma
text: Just a chance to get used to driving on your own.

speaker: You
text: Three hours doesn't exactly sound like easing me into it...

speaker: Grandma
text: *laughs* You'll be fine.

speaker: Grandma
text: Actually, let me grab a couple of things before you go.

speaker: You
text: What else do I need?

speaker: Grandma
text: A few things for the journey.

speaker: You
text: Okay...

speaker: Grandma
text: And dear?

speaker: You
text: Yeah?

speaker: Grandma
text: Pay attention on the road.

speaker: You
text: You know I always do.

speaker: Grandma
text: I know.

speaker: Grandma
text: But today, try looking a little further than the road ahead of you.

speaker: You
text: ...What does that mean?

speaker: Grandma
text: You'll figure it out.

speaker: You
text: Oh, I almost forgot!

speaker: You
text: Come on Monty, let's go!
